I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice…
When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”
When I looked, behold, a hand was stretched out to me; and, behold, a scroll of a book was in it.
He spread it before me. It was written within and without; and lamentations, mourning, and woe were written in it.

translations.web: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.
translations.bsb: He held in his hand a small scroll, which lay open. He placed his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
translations.kjv: And he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left foot on the earth,
translations.asv: and he had in his hand a little book open: and he set his right foot upon the sea, and his left upon the earth;
